description:
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying its mana cost.
When Reckless Barbarian enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
